alternative_explanations: The six-bin table may merely select an NLMS step already matched by a fixed classical updater.
Anonymous heterogeneous trajectories may not share an update geometry even when their world-local predictors are identifiable.
confounds: The fixed linear predictor class can limit quality independently of the learned update law.
One runner-random seed estimates no cross-seed variance and candidate costs are deterministic operation models rather than hardware complexity.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any candidate receives a family label, source path, native type or semantic channel name.
Invalidate if normalization reads a holdout output or any value outside assigned slow-fit worlds.
Invalidate if a history, support or forecast window crosses a whole-world or DS08a cycle boundary.
Invalidate if shared, independent, cross-family-only or support-only changes learner source or hyperparameters.
Invalidate if masked loss is not averaged within world and equally across the three evaluator-private families.
Invalidate if acquisition, normalization, fit, adaptation, query, update, bytes, state or R1/R4/R16 cost is omitted.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, scoring-seed leakage, external model/API use or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard if shared minus independent is not greater than 0.03806855146519833 in every evaluator-private family and K=4/6/9 cell.
Discard if cross-family-only minus support-only is not greater than 0.03806855146519833 in every evaluator-private family and K=4/6/9 cell.
Discard if stable rollout is below 1, worst-family quality regresses, or any fixed complete implementable control Pareto-dominates shared under universal axes including update_ops.
Invalidate on contract, source identity, seed policy, target access, baseline semantics, preflight or evaluator integrity mismatch.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify the exact transferable update-law claim and stop this direction without tuning.
outcome_policy.null: Return HYP-0029 to dormant and do not tune bins, rates, initialization, predictor class or state size.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only an unchanged three-seed replication of the exact table, constants and v7 contract.

predicted_outcome: The shared and cross-family-only learned rate tables exceed their source-identical ablations by more than 0.03806855146519833 in every family and K cell, remain stable, avoid worst-family regression and are not Pareto-dominated after full cost.
promotion_criteria: A one-seed quick cannot promote; a complete positive may authorize only unchanged three-seed replication.
research_question: Can a six-scalar family-blind update law learned from anonymous source trajectories improve unseen-world adaptation over source-identical and fixed classical controls without transferring world parameters?
title: Source-identical transferable local update law quick
